messages:
olivia: Hey all — I'm starting this week and can't find where to get a hosted API key vs sandbox key. How do I request hosted access and what's the difference in quotas/rate limits?

matt: Welcome! Hosted key = real production quota billed per-token. Sandbox = free dev quota with lower limits. For most initial dev work use sandbox. To get hosted you need to file the 'Hosted Key Request' form (link) — try here: https://intranet/redwood/self-serve/hosted-key 

olivia: Thanks. Is there a quick checklist for streaming and 429s? I saw a bunch of 429s in my test loop.

devex-bot: Reminder: new hires automatically get a sandbox key with 50k tokens/day for the first two weeks. Hosted keys require manager approval.

matt: For 429s check rate limits and whether you're using the streaming endpoint. Streaming has separate concurrency limits. If you hit 429s, add exponential backoff + jitter and respect the Retry-After header. 

sanjay: If you're looping high-concurrency tests, drop concurrency to 2-3 and use batching. Also ensure you're not reusing the sandbox key across shared CI.

kelly: Here's an example curl for hosted (use sandbox by swapping endpoint and key):

```bash
curl -s -N "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED_HOSTED_KEY>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-1.3","input":"hello"}'
```

charlie: For hosted quota increases ping #eng-sre with your workspace ID and approx tokens/day. For urgent short-lived bursts we have a 'burst' toggle you can ask infra to enable.

olivia: Great — who should I contact if the Hosted Key Request form errors? I got a 500 earlier.

matt: @sanjay can you check the form? Otherwise email devex@redwood.com with a screenshot.

sanjay: Saw it this morning, it's flaky while the migration runs. If you get a 500, include your user id and the error id from the form response. We'll provision manually.

olivia: Awesome, thanks everyone! Starting with sandbox tests now. ping me if I should add sample prompts for the onboarding eval.

matt: Please do — also add a short prompt set and expected outputs to the onboarding doc. :thumbsup:
